purpose: Provenance of the liveness helper fixtures in liveness-fixtures/ and of the hand-measured values check-liveness.test.mjs expects.

reduction.command: node .backups/verification/2026-10-10-operating-tool-guards/tdd/work/build-liveness-fixtures.mjs (run from the repository root, stdout kept in the same folder as build-liveness-fixtures.out.json)
rules: the envelope of the source CLI output is kept (inbox: id/ok/result.messages/result.count/_meta; check: the whole result object; wait: the leading _keepalive lines verbatim and the result)
only the messages of the named Dispatches and the replies whose thread_id is one of their questions are kept, in source order; result.count is set to the kept number
message fields kept: id, type, from_handle, to_handle, thread_id, created_at, sequence (when the source has it), subject, payload; body and the other fields are removed
payload is reduced to taskId, dispatchId, phase and outcome and written back in the source form (JSON string or object); question text, filesModified and reportPath are removed
no time, gap or decision is computed by the builder
